name: Build / setup failure
traceRegex: (?is).*(\[build failed\]|\[setup failed\]|panic: |fatal error: |test timed out after).*

name: Infrastructure
traceRegex: (?is).*(docker|podman|testcontainers|ryuk|toxiproxy|connection refused|connection reset|no such host|i/o timeout|context deadline exceeded|exited before becoming ready|not 200 within|service binary .* no such file).*
